Every boss you defeat drops 1 to 5 elemental shards: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Dark or Light.
Each map only drops its own two kinds of shard. The Swamp gives Dark and Ice, the Magical Forest Light and Lightning.
Hunting for Fire shards? The Castle, the Desert and the Ashen Caldera all drop them.
Spend shards in the Forge to upgrade your signature weapon, up to level 10. Click the weapon on the character select to open it.
Short on shards? The Forge sells any kind for 150 coins each.
Every Forge level adds 25% damage and 8% attack rate, and level 1 unlocks your weapon's own special trick.
You start a run with one ability. The second unlocks at level 5 and your ultimate at level 10.
Abilities recharge on a cooldown: about 30 seconds, 45 seconds and 2 minutes. A ready ability pulses on the bar.
Hold Alt to pause and inspect: hover an ability or one of your upgrades to see exactly what it does.
Chests only open with a key of their own tier: bronze, silver or gold. Walk up to one with its key and press E.
Elites sometimes drop chest keys. Keys don't carry over to the next run, so use them!
Opening a chest spins a slot machine of your abilities. Three of a kind gives that ability +3 levels, and gold chests hit it most often.
Chests are the only way to level up abilities. At level 10 an ability is four times as strong and recharges 40% faster.
Epic enemies drop potions: purple cuts your cooldowns, red heals and blue gives you a shield. Potions never disappear.
Elites can drop power-ups like Magnet, Fear Idol and 5x Damage. Press E to grab one, but hurry: they vanish after 45 seconds.
Luck brings more epic enemies (and their drops) and better odds of Rare, Epic and Legendary upgrade cards.
You can carry four weapons and four kinds of tome in a run. Once your slots are full, only those level up, so choose carefully.
Don't like a card? BAN it for 100 coins and it won't come back this run. You get three bans per run.
A Legendary card you don't need can be converted into a chest key instead.
Coins come from time survived and from kills, but they're only banked on the end screen. Quitting a run forfeits them.
Bosses arrive at 8:00. Leave one alive too long and it enrages, attacking much faster.
Boss attacks are always marked on the ground first, filling up red. You always get at least a second to move.
At 75%, 50% and 10% health a boss unleashes its ultimate. Thog's Quake can only be survived in a pool: follow the green arrows!
When a boss ultimate starts, find the safe spot: golden circles for the Pharaoh, holy ground for the Necromancer, raised islands for Singe.
Beat each map's boss to open the next map: the Swamp, the Magical Forest, the Castle, the Desert, the Graveyard, then the Ashen Caldera.
New champions are bought with coins on the character select. Some, like Thog, must first be beaten on their home turf.
Every run earns your character EXP. Each character level gives a skill point for their skill tree, and the Special column opens at level 5.
Ultimates set the woods ablaze. Burnt trees crumble away for good, opening new escape routes.
Jump the moment you land to keep your momentum, and strafe while airborne to pick up even more speed.
Slide while running for a burst of speed. Sliding downhill speeds you up, and a slide-jump keeps it.
Swamp water halves your speed and jump height. The goblins wade slowly too.
Unrelenting mode has no time limit and no level cap. Survive 15 minutes in the Swamp to earn a rare feat.
